candidates.review_note: Fix n modulo p-1 to determine a^n, then solve n modulo p and combine the coprime congruences explicitly. Each residue class has period p(p-1), with a positive representative because b is nonzero. Iterate inverse powers in O(p).
For positive digital root d, x=d+9t, so xD(x)=d²+9dt. Deduplicate the union of these nine arithmetic progressions in their common period9*lcm(1..9), then answer ranges with exact cycle counts.

Eliminate the interior point from its three squared distances to equilateral vertices. The valid enclosing triangle uses the larger quadratic root for side²; multiply by sqrt(3)/4 for area. Clamp only negative floating roundoff of the theoretically nonnegative discriminant.

Normalize names as specified, form a bipartite graph from groups to required initial letters, and find a perfect matching by augmenting paths. Output names in initial-letter order; the source guarantees uniqueness.

DP holds the least cost for every integer fuel level0..200 at each station. Shift levels by traveled distance and relax unlimited purchases one liter at a time. Arrival requires remaining distance plus100 liters; preserve blank-line case separation.

For a proposed separation, subset DP retains the earliest possible last landing for each set of aircraft, considering every ordering. Binary-search feasible separation in seconds, then round the final optimum to nearest second as required.
The public input contains consecutive triples B,P,M until EOF, with no case-count header. Use exact modular exponentiation, including exponent zero and modulus one.

Outside the first and last differing positions, the common supersequence is fixed. Inside, one deletion must precede the other, giving two possible one-character shifts; each succeeds exactly when the shifted interiors agree. Distinct source words guarantee a differing interval.

Memoize a subset of target areas and its smaller rectangle side; total area determines the other side. Every first guillotine cut partitions the subset into two nonempty parts with a shared width or height. Enumerate partitions once by anchoring the lowest bit and recurse only on integral cuts.

Use exact rational ternary expansion and detect repeating remainders, avoiding a fixed digit cutoff. A digit1 excludes membership except when it terminates the expansion, where the alternative trailing2 representation is valid. Include endpoints0 and1.

The minority group creates at most minority+1 gaps for the majority, so the optimum is ceil(majority/(minority+1)), achieved by distributing as evenly as possible. Includes an empty gender and the -1 -1 terminator.
